notes.title: One Week Left to get Chequered Ink's Greatest Hits on Cassette Tape USB
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Thank you for supporting us & helping us to celebrate ten years of making games.

We just wanted to remind you that the [url=https://limitedrungames.com/collections/all-games/products/chequered-ink-greatest-hits-pc]Limited Run x Chequered Ink Greatest Hits tape[/url] is only on sale for one more week. Pre-orders end on Sunday April 27th.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23893909/b980446e1e6debb9346b1dae8d7cf359940aa911.jpg[/img]

This collector's item features ten of the best Chequered Ink games from the last decade:

[list]
[*] Innoquous 5: A mind-bending gravity-flipping platformer
[*] Gyro Boss DX: Dodge an endless assault of wacky weapons from a big, bad boss
[*] Maddening Euphoria: Escape the wall as you run around in circles
[*] Cryptrio: Match three madness with a spooky twist
[*] Revolver and Co: The quiz game where you shoot killer robots with your knowledge
[*] Plunder Dungeons: The deck-building dungeon crawler with the silliest weapons and outfits
[*] Ink Cipher: Classic code-breaking to engage your brain
[*] Spellworm: Feed the hungry worm words & letters to solve puzzles
[*] Monoquous 2: A physics-defying platformer where everything is black and white
[*] Non-stop Space Probe: Blast through space as a rocket that never stops
[/list]

PLUS - 1200 of our fonts with commercial use license for use in your own projects.

We hope you all had a fantastic Easter and we look forward to the next 10 years of sharing our games, fonts and assets with you all!

[url=https://limitedrungames.com/collections/all-games/products/chequered-ink-greatest-hits-pc]Get the Chequered Ink Greatest Hits Tape here.[/url]

All the best,

Daniel and Allison

notes.title: Tenth Anniversary: 10 games & 1200 fonts on tape!
notes.content:
Here at Chequered Ink, we’re celebrating our tenth anniversary as an indie game development studio with a cassette tape USB featuring our best games from the last decade - including [b]Innoquous 5[/b]!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/23893909/b980446e1e6debb9346b1dae8d7cf359940aa911.jpg[/img]

We’ve teamed up with [url=https://limitedrungames.com/collections/all-games/products/chequered-ink-greatest-hits-pc]Limited Run Games[/url] to create a unique, collectible piece of indie history. Chequered Ink’s Greatest Hits includes the following ten games:

[list]
[*] [b]Innoquous 5:[/b] A mind-bending gravity-flipping platformer
[*] [b]Gyro Boss DX:[/b] Dodge an endless assault of wacky weapons from a big, bad boss
[*] [b]Maddening Euphoria:[/b] Escape the wall as you run around in circles
[*] [b]Cryptrio:[/b] Match three madness with a spooky twist
[*] [b]Revolver and Co:[/b] The quiz game where you shoot killer robots with your knowledge
[*] [b]Plunder Dungeons:[/b] The deck-building dungeon crawler with the silliest weapons and outfits
[*] [b]Ink Cipher:[/b] Classic code-breaking to engage your brain
[*] [b]Spellworm:[/b] Feed the hungry worm words & letters to solve puzzles
[*] [b]Monoquous 2:[/b] A physics-defying platformer where everything is black and white
[*] [b]Non-stop Space Probe:[/b] Blast through space as a rocket that never stops
[/list]

Also included on the tape are [b]all 1200 Chequered Ink Fonts for commercial use[/b]. Bring your designs to life with fonts in every kind of style, from scribbly handwriting to graceful calligraphy and everything in between!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/23893909/8cf8e6a6e201f9d7d1e57fc49708de193c0c75dd.jpg[/img]

The Greatest Hits USB Tape is available on pre-order from [b]March 25th to April 27th, 2025[/b] for $29.99 – which represents a HUGE saving versus the cost of buying all of our games and fonts individually, plus you get a cool retro trinket for your video game collection. What’s not to like?

As a Limited Run release, this is the ONLY time you’ll be able to get your hands on the Chequered Ink Greatest Hits Tape. Check it out on the Limited Run Games website here:

[url=https://limitedrungames.com/collections/all-games/products/chequered-ink-greatest-hits-pc]Chequered Ink Greatest Hits Tape[/url]

notes.title: Level tweaks & completability
notes.content:
Innoquous 5 has been updated to make some of the late-game levels actually possible to complete in game modes beyond Standard. Others are fairer - for example, Hop 3 only needs to be "completed" twice in Conditional, rather than three times.

There are also a couple of minor fixes, such as the controls being a bit iffy in levels where the condition reverses left and right inputs, and the bunny being readded to a level where it didn't appear in Bunny Hunt - no bunny left un-captured.
